scripts.test:e2e:ios: xcodegen generate && xcodebuild test -project LukiFitti.xcodeproj -scheme LukiFittiIOS -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -only-testing:LukiFittiIOSUITests -skip-testing:LukiFittiIOSUITests/MarketingScreenshotsUITests -skip-testing:LukiFittiIOSUITests/AppReviewWalkthroughUITests CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.test:e2e:watch: xcodegen generate && xcodebuild test -project LukiFitti.xcodeproj -scheme LukiFittiWatch -destination 'platform=watchOS Simulator,name=Apple Watch Ultra 4 (49mm)' -only-testing:LukiFittiWatchUITests -skip-testing:LukiFittiWatchUITests/MarketingScreenshotsUITests CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.marketing:check: bash -c 'v=$(grep -m1 MARKETING_VERSION project.yml | sed -E "s/.*\"([0-9.]+)\".*/\1/"); g=$(cat marketing/VERSION 2>/dev/null || echo none); [ "${v%.*}" = "${g%.*}" ] || { echo "Marketing screenshots were generated for $g, app version is $v — minor and major releases need new screenshots: run yarn workspace @luki-fitti/apple marketing:screenshots" >&2; exit 1; }; echo "marketing images are for $g (app $v; patch releases reuse them)"'
